quests.name: Grim Message
quests.text: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike. Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.

quests.name: Gryphon Master Talonaxe
quests.text: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe inside the Aerie Peak Aviary.

quests.name: Rhapsody Shindigger
quests.text: Seek out Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Kalimdor Kocktail
quests.text: Rhapsody Shindigger in The Hinterlands wants you to bring him 3 Roc Gizzards, 3 Groddoc Livers and 3 Ironfur Livers.

quests.name: Rhapsody's Tale
quests.text: Bring the Atal'ai Tablet Fragment to Brohann Caskbelly in Stormwind.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
quests.text: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Return to Fel'Zerul
quests.text: Return to Fel'Zerul in Stonard.

quests.name: Troll Necklace Bounty
quests.text: Bring 5 Troll Tribal Necklaces to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
quests.text: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
quests.text: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

quests.name: Witherbark Cages
quests.text: Check the cages at the two Witherbark villages, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

quests.name: Thadius Grimshade
quests.text: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.

quests.name: The Divination
quests.text: Wait until Grimshade performs the ritual of divination.

quests.name: Return to the Hinterlands
quests.text: Speak with Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

quests.name: Rin'ji is Trapped!
quests.text: Escort Rin'ji out of the Quel'Danil Lodge, then find his hidden secret at the Overlook Cliffs to the east.

quests.name: Rin'ji's Secret
quests.text: Oran Snakewrithe, a well known scholar on matters concerning the Witherbark trolls, may be able to decipher the tablet. She is known to reside within the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.

quests.name: Skulk Rock Clean-up
quests.text: Kill 10 Green Sludges and 10 Jade Oozes, and then report back to Fraggar Thundermantle in Aerie Peak.

quests.name: The Altar of Zul
quests.text: Check the top of the Altar of Zul, then return to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

quests.name: A Sticky Situation
quests.text: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Find OOX-09/HL!
quests.text: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot at the head of the river in the Hinterlands, near Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-09/HL!
quests.text: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

objectives.text: Escort OOX-09/HL to the shoreline beyond Overlook Cliff

quests.name: Gammerita, Mon!
quests.text: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.  Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.

quests.name: Stalking the Stalkers
quests.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Silvermane Stalkers and 10 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.  Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Hunt the Savages
quests.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.  Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Avenging the Fallen
quests.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.  Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
quests.text: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.  You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

quests.name: Message to the Wildhammer
quests.text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.  You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
quests.text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.  Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
quests.text: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.  Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Repurposed Totems
quests.text: Bring 12 Vilebranch Totems back to Maret Firetend.

quests.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
quests.text: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.  Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

quests.name: Witch Doctor Ti'ik
quests.text: Kill the Witherbark witch doctor known as Ti'ik in a cave west of Hiri'watha and return with his head.

quests.name: The Ancient Egg
quests.text: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

quests.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
quests.text: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

quests.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
quests.text: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.  Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

quests.name: Separation Anxiety
quests.text: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.  Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

quests.name: Dark Vessels
quests.text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

quests.name: Saving Sharpbeak
quests.text: Fight to the top of Jintha'Alor, kill Vile Priestess Hexx for the key to Sharpbeak's cage, and save Sharpbeak.

quests.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
quests.text: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.  You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Recover the Key!
quests.text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torntusk when you have recovered the key.

quests.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
quests.text: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

quests.name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
quests.text: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.  Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
quests.text: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.  Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Jammal'an the Prophet
quests.text: The Atal'ai Exile in The Hinterlands wants the Head of Jammal'an.

quests.name: Summoning Shadra
quests.text: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Venom to the Undercity
quests.text: Bring Faranell's Parcel to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
